sections.shortTitle: Sindh Speakers and Deputy Speakers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Second Amendment Act 1989
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XV OF 1989
ACT XV OF 1989
SINDH SPEAKER'S
AND DEPUTY SPEAKER'S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT,
1989
An Act to amend
the Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
Act, 1975
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part-IV 31, December, 1989]
No. PAS/Legis-B-14/89 dated
31-12-1989--The Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances
and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1989 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 29th November, 1989 and assented to by the Governor of
Sindh on 19th December, 1989 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature
of Sindh.
1. Short title and
commencement--(1). This Act may be called the Sindh Speaker's and Deputy
Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Insertion of Section 7-A in Sindh Act, VII of 1975

ACT XV OF 1989
ACT XV OF 1989
SINDH SPEAKER'S
AND DEPUTY SPEAKER'S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT,
1989
An Act to amend
the Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
Act, 1975
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part-IV 31, December, 1989]
No. PAS/Legis-B-14/89 dated
31-12-1989--The Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances
and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1989 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 29th November, 1989 and assented to by the Governor of
Sindh on 19th December, 1989 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature
of Sindh.
2. Insertion of Section 7-A in
Sindh Act, VII of 1975.--In the Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975, hereinafter referred to as the
said Act, after section 7, the following new section shall be inserted:--
"7-A(1)
[Discretionary Grants] The Speaker may in his discretion make grants to the
extent of fifty thousand rupees in a year:
(2) The accounts
of the grants shall be audited annually by the Accountant-General, Sindh or his
nominee."

Sindh Act VII of 1975.--In the said Act, after section 8, the following new

"8-A.

of two telephones at his office and two telephones at his residence."
